svg.title: B04 + B17 / Merchant's house on the fountain
svg.text: B04 + B17 / Merchant's house on the fountain
A merchant block has a quiet court loggia on its west front and a cloth-trade back on the Souk, with the existing cross-link between its wings.
Source shells / roofs; rust = design extent, not a live transform.
M01: TWO WINGS / ONE ROOF OWNER EACH
Shared shell union x36..41: overlap4.6 m, outer strips0.2 m.
Passage y39..44 stays open. Souk massing IDs own common
roof/backing; court modules remain. North door serves north wing
only; south is front-served locked stock. Retain repaired arches.
Opening shapes are schematic; retained repaired frames are not redesigned. Source roof boxes are a static survey, not a live scene
or clearance pass. Dimensions and relationships: buildings.md; assemblies/export bounds: assets.md.
METRES / solid ink: retained grey dashed: current replaced envelope rust: proposal green: route
